== Summary ==
Original Players Committee Virtual slip: Hyperwave Scan (V), from the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Page 3, right column, row 5, slip “36”. Old pre-template slip (before the Players Committee remastered the set in December 2006). Cropped unchanged from a 300 dpi render of the PDF page (no retouching).

Source: https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=3

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-4/4e/VS3-2002-36-Hyperwave_Scan.png Internet Archive item].
